class.name: NetwDatabaseConnection
class.brief_description: Reads and writes the records of one open slot.
class.description: Subclass it, together with a [NetwDatabaseBackend] whose [method NetwDatabaseBackend._open] returns it, to store records somewhere the shipped backends do not. Implement [method _read], [method _scan], [method _write_batch] and [method _close]. [NetwDatabase] builds every other operation from these. Each returns a [NetwPromise], and a method left unimplemented rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. [b]Address[/b] Reads, scans and writes name a record with this [Dictionary]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴kind int 0 for a record, 1 for a table snapshot ┠╴schema_name String the schema the record belongs to ┖╴key String the record's durable id [/codeblock] An envelope is a record as [NetwDatabase] hands it to you. Store it as given and return it unchanged.

method.name: _close
method.description: Releases this slot. It is called after every pending operation has finished. [method NetwDatabase.close] does not wait for this promise.

method.name: _read
method.description: Reads the record at [param address] and resolves a reply. A record that is not stored is [code]found[/code] [code]false[/code] with [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. Set [code]error[/code] only when storage could not be read. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error OK, or why storage could not be asked ┠╴detail String a human-readable explanation, empty when error is OK ┠╴found bool whether a record is stored at address ┖╴envelope Dictionary the envelope last written to address, only when found [/codeblock]

method.name: _scan
method.description: Reads one page of records matching [param request] and resolves a reply. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴schema_name String the schema every record in the page belongs to ┠╴kind int the address kind, 0 for a record ┠╴filter Dictionary the filter the game passed to NetwDatabase.scan ┠╴cursor String the previous page's cursor, empty on the first page ┖╴limit int the most records one page may carry [/codeblock] Return a nonempty [code]cursor[/code] while records remain, even when the page is shorter than [code]limit[/code]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error OK, or why the page could not be read ┠╴detail String a human-readable explanation, empty when error is OK ┠╴records Array[Dictionary] │ ┖╴record │ ┠╴key String the record's durable id │ ┖╴envelope Dictionary the envelope last written to it ┖╴cursor String where the next page starts, empty when the scan is done [/codeblock]

method.name: _write_batch
method.description: Applies [param operations] in order and resolves one outcome per operation, in the same order. Each one replaces or erases a whole record. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴operation ┠╴kind String "replace" or "erase" ┠╴address Dictionary the record's address, see the class description ┖╴envelope Dictionary the record to store, replace only [/codeblock] Report [constant @GlobalScope.OK] only once storage has confirmed the operation. When a timeout leaves the outcome unknown, mark it uncertain. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴error Error OK, or a failure of the whole batch ┠╴detail String a human-readable explanation, empty when error is OK ┠╴errors PackedInt32Array one Error per operation ┖╴uncertain PackedByteArray 1 where the outcome is unknown, 0 otherwise [/codeblock] An [code]errors[/code] of the wrong length fails every operation with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_DATA].

method.name: close_default
method.description: The stock [method _close], which succeeds without doing anything. A subclass overriding [method _close] calls this to reach it.

method.name: read_default
method.description: The stock [method _read], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _read] calls this to reach it.

method.name: scan_default
method.description: The stock [method _scan], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _scan] calls this to reach it.

method.name: write_batch_default
method.description: The stock [method _write_batch], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _write_batch] calls this to reach it.
